definitions.ask: Should a rename add an id to a reference that has none?
definitions.why: 77 PDF-backed refs were created without --include-id on purpose

choices.label: Id-less references stay id-less; renaming them leaves the PDF bytes untouched
Renames write id = new stem into the note and PDF marker, so every renamed ref gains an id

definitions.ask: Should the coder re-key the live vault's mismatched references once the fix passes its tests?
definitions.why: The eight live violations are the visible symptom; each repair is one revertable commit

definitions.ask: Should a new decisions record replace the rename-keeps-id claim, marking the old record superseded in part?
definitions.corrects: It keeps the reference's `id`, `^ref-…` block ID, title, `source_url`, dates, PDF marker, and PDF bytes.
